Candidate total missed required actions must not increase in either historical repetition.
No candidate safety failure or new invalid final proposal in any case.
Candidate constructed-control full-case passes must not decrease in either repetition, and all designated positive link/component controls must pass in both candidate repetitions.
Candidate supplemental unsupported-reference count must not increase in either repetition; this checks all proposed references, beyond the frozen scorer's refs_any intersection.
